fields.Name: ORD-01 - Order Booking
fields.Description: Confirming an order writes correct, balanced double-entry into accounting's ledger, atomically (OB1-OB14). One journal entry per line, each single-company and resolved through product -> category -> company; the D25 origin pair points at the order line; a deferred product credits Deferred Revenue; a discount with no contra account nets into the sales credit; and a line whose GL role cannot resolve rejects the WHOLE confirm leaving neither entries nor a confirmed order. OB13 adds the ExpectedGrossTotal guard - a migration or a stale quote that silently reprices at today's rates is a defect that looks exactly like a successful import, so a moved total refuses the confirm and leaves no ledger behind. OB14 asserts a back-dated order books on the date it states, because back-office entry exists precisely because the event preceded the record.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 3 balanced entries across 2 companies; deferred line credits 21301; discounted line credits 135 net; unresolvable line rejects the confirm with zero residue.
